question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE is_promo = TRUE
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
)

    CASE WHEN total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
         ELSE promo_net / total_net 
    END AS promo_net_ratio
FROM promo_sales, total_sales

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        d.month,
        SUM(f.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month IN (7, 8)
    GROUP BY p.category, d.month
)
SELECT 
    a.category
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b 
    ON a.category = b.category 
    AND a.month = 8 
    AND b.month = 7
WHERE a.total_qty > b.total_qty

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.outlet_id, p.sku_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    CROSS JOIN dim_product p
    WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.is_active = TRUE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM rel_outlet_sku ros
          WHERE ros.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND ros.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND (ros.delisted_date IS NULL OR ros.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
            AND ros.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fact_sales fs
          JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
          WHERE fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND fs.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND dd.year = 2026
            AND dd.month = 8
      )
) t

WITH inventory_days AS (
    SELECT 
        d.dealer_id,
        d.dealer_name,
        SUM(fi.qty_on_hand * p.unit_cost) AS inventory_value,
        SUM(fs.net_amount) AS sales_value,
        CASE

        AND fs.date_key BETWEEN dd.date_key - 30 AND dd.date_key
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.month = 8
    GROUP BY d.dealer_id, d.dealer_name
)
SELECT dealer_name
FROM inventory_days
ORDER BY turnover_days DESC
LIMIT 10

    WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter IN (3, 4)

    FROM fact_promo_cost fpc
    JOIN dim_date dd ON fpc.date_key = dd.date_key
    WHERE dd.year = 2026 AND dd.quarter IN (1, 2)
),

    (c26.total_cost / NULLIF(s26.total_sales, 0)) - (c25.total_cost / NULLIF(s25.total_sales, 0)) AS fee_ratio_diff
